verdicts.reason: Both rebuild the maroon panel and text stack the same way, and the type stays legible. In both, the decorative X, slashes and circle are scattered instead of framing the panel's corners: the top-right slash is moved below the panel and the lower-left slash and circle sit far away, at the bottom. In both, the cropped photo shows awkward arm fragments at the top and bottom. A centres the panel vertically, so the space above and below is more balanced. B pushes the panel up near the top, with the X jammed against the top edge, which leaves a big empty photo area below with stray decoration in it.
